channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Allen Iverson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Allen Iverson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Grant Williams on Allen Iverson, Boris Diaw, Chuck Hayes, Draymond Green
item.description:
Grant Williams on collecting NBA trading cards:

“Allen Iverson, his market has just ballooned over the past year and a half, two years. So that was pretty cool. And then last but not least, I'm actually auctioning one of my two Allen Iverson cards in an auction here in the next couple weeks, which is exciting. I think I had a smaller Chuck Hayes card, which is kind of embarrassing to say. Listen, I love players that were my size and were playing in the league. So like Chuck Hayes, Draymond Green, Boris Diaw, those were like my favorite players growing up because they looked like me and gave me a chance.”

Grant Williams on Allen Iverson, Boris Diaw, Chuck Hayes, Draymond Green, Sep 27, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nick Van Exel on Allen Iverson
item.description:
Nick Van Exel on Allen Iverson:

“I'm going to tell you something even crazier. I don't know if he was doing it back then, but the [expletive] used to have a party every city he went to, and come out and give you 35.It was definitely a flyer out there every single city. It was crazy. We were playing in Washington, so we go to a little spot in Washington. We're sitting up in there, and the waitress brought us two bottles. We're in D.C., and she brought us two bottles. We're like, 'Who these come from?' Look over in the corner, it's Allen Iverson. You’re playing in Philly, and he’s in DC”

Nick Van Exel on Allen Iverson, Sep 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Channing Frye on Chris Paul, Allen Iverson
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“I think Allen Iverson is the one of the top three most influential players ever to play basketball. Butif we're looking at careers, Chris Paul's career is better than Allen Iverson's.”

Channing Frye on Chris Paul, Allen Iverson, Aug 8, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Becky Hammon on Allen Iverson, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“Allen Iverson got MVP and he lost in the finals. I think the two best teams are probably in the West, but I’m up for being proven wrong. That’s the other thing, I think Jalen Brunson’s a hell of a player, a hell of a player. I’m speaking historically on the NBA with what I said. I don’t know why everybody’s so stuck on that. I said it two years ago.“I said what I said. If he proves me wrong, he proves me wrong.”

Becky Hammon on Allen Iverson, Jalen Brunson, May 26, 2026. Source: Associated Press.

item.title: Austin Rivers on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, James Harden
item.description:
Fullcourtpass: Austin Rivers on scoring in the NBA

“LeBron James doesn’t have half the offensive bag that Kevin [Durant]has…I would say Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, James Harden, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, and Allen Iverson are the best scorers I’ve ever seen”

Austin Rivers on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, James Harden, Aug 13, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Allen Iverson, Steve Nash, Gilbert Arenas, Richard Hamilton
item.description:
When asked about the players who influenced his style, CJ McCollum rattled off a list of all-time greats.

“Besides my brother? I watched a lot of Allen Iverson. I watched a lot of Steve Nash. I watched a lot of Rip Hamilton. I watched young Gilbert [Arenas] and obviously Kobe and Mike,”

CJ McCollum on Allen Iverson, Steve Nash, Gilbert Arenas, Richard Hamilton, Mar 23, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Allen Iverson
item.description:
Andre Iguodala:

“Allen Iverson gets such a bad rep, but he's one of the classiest guys I've ever met, with one of the biggest hearts. He doesn't get the credit he deserves as a person. He was the one who put confidence in me. Everyone needs that person to let them know who they are because sometimes you just don’t know. I was a late bloomer, didn’t even know why agents were calling me. They’d call, saying they wanted to represent me, and I’d be like, 'For what?' That’s how unaware I was. AI let me know I belonged, told me I was just as good as anyone out there. He inspired me to believe in myself and own my potential.”

Andre Iguodala on Allen Iverson, Nov 10, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Vernon Maxwell on Allen Iverson
item.description:
Vernon Maxwell:

“He kicked me off the team for nothing, though—in the finals. I mean, we was getting to the finals against the Lakers, and I’d been playing the whole damn series. I didn’t get a chance to play in that series because he said I wasn’t… I can’t make Allen Iverson do what Allen Iverson don’t want to do. He’s the franchise player on the team. They brought me in because I’d won two championships, wanted me to show him how to be a leader, and all that. But I can’t tell this little dude what to do. You know, that’s Allen Iverson. You’re talking to a brick wall. Why are you talking to me? He’s not listening to nobody. This dude already carried you to the finals. You don’t tell him what to do.”

Vernon Maxwell on Allen Iverson, Nov 1, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Vince Carter, Dwyane Wade, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Tracy McGrady, James Harden
item.description:
Gilbert Arenas:

“If we really want to have this discussion about Jordan’s competition, just look at the top five shooting guards in history. He didn’t play against any of them in their prime. Kobe’s number two, but he had a young Kobe in ’98. Then you have Allen Iverson, Dwyane Wade, James Harden, Tracy McGrady, Vince Carter—Jordan didn’t face these guys. History is showing you who’s who now because time has gone by.”

Gilbert Arenas on Vince Carter, Dwyane Wade, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Tracy McGrady, James Harden, Aug 28, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Allen Iverson
item.description:
Robinson:Kobe Bryant’s ‘96 Draft class was better than Michael Jordan’s ‘84 Draft Class and LeBron’s ‘03 class says Stephon Marbury.

“Not only from the basketball perspective. I think culturally we were the guys that were able to take it from one space to the next space. Not just in basketball but the culture movement. You look at guys like Allen Iverson, he made it ok to be what Allen Iverson is and a lot of kids were able to follow.”

LeBron James on Allen Iverson, Aug 15, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Allen Iverson
item.description:
Udonis Haslem revealed that he was almost traded for Allen Iverson so Miami could pair him with Dwyane Wade:

“I remember my name was in the hat one time. We was talking about making a move for Iverson and my name got thrown in the hat a little bit. I was all shook up and (expletive), but D-Wade was like ‘Man, that’s Allen Iverson’.”

Dwyane Wade on Allen Iverson, Jun 4, 2024. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: John Wall on Carmelo Anthony, Allen Iverson
item.description:
“I think about my favorite player, Allen Iverson. They asked him to come off the bench and do those things in different places, and there’s no way AI shouldn’t have still been in the league, you know what I mean? It’s just that pride didn’t let him go. You look at [Carmelo Anthony]. He accepted his pride. He was back with the Lakers last year. I’m not trying to be one of those guys on the outside looking in. I’m trying to keep it as cool as I can and stay in this position.”

John Wall on Carmelo Anthony, Allen Iverson, Dec 10, 2022. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Allen Iverson
item.description:
“He's a unique player. A lot of athleticism and creativity out there. Body type reminds you of somebody like -- well he's taller than A.I. [Allen Iverson], but a wiry, strong player ... but he's an incredible player, man.”

Kevin Durant on Allen Iverson, Oct 24, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Allen Iverson
item.description:
CJ McCollum on finding a balance between scoring/passing:

“I played with a guy who scored 50 more times than Allen Iverson. I know how to share the ball. I know how to let somebody go when they’re in a rhythm, in a groove. I’m comfortable doing whatever it takes to win.”

CJ McCollum on Allen Iverson, Oct 2, 2022. Source: Twitter @cclark_13.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Allen Iverson
item.description:
Lillard had his favorites — Michael Jordan, Kobe Bryant, LeBron James, Carmelo Anthony, Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Allen Iverson — but it was Iverson whom he held in the highest regard.

“I was imitating Iverson because he was small, and he had that neighborhood energy,”

Damian Lillard on Allen Iverson, Nov 10, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: World B. Free on Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird
item.description:
former Warrior World B. Free said.

“It’s a person that just knows what he’s doing, knows he’s good. Not many guys have it. You know Michael Jordan had it. Magic Johnson. Larry Bird. Dr. J. Allen Iverson. It factors. When you see those guys coming, you know you’re in for a long night.”

World B. Free on Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Apr 13, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Rich Paul on Allen Iverson
item.description:
Rich Paul, CEO and founder of Klutch Sports Group, the agency behind the careers of NBA superstars like LeBron James and Anthony Davis, shared his thoughts on what could have been with Allen Iverson.

“Allen Iverson’s impact post-Michael Jordan was second-to-none. Give me Allen Iverson leaving Georgetown, coming into the league, and today Allen Iverson will have a billion-dollar brand,”

Rich Paul on Allen Iverson, Mar 31, 2021. Source: Front Office Sports.

item.title: Rich Paul on Allen Iverson
item.description:
“The business to be built with Allen Iverson would’ve been still sustainable today. I think he would’ve been neck-and-neck with the ‘Black Cat’ [Jordan],”

Rich Paul on Allen Iverson, Mar 31, 2021. Source: Front Office Sports.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Allen Iverson
item.description:
“I'm not gonna lie, I was scared to death -- I could play defense and all, but I knew I couldn't slide my feet with Allen Iverson.”

Paul Pierce on Allen Iverson, May 18, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Sergio Rodriguez on Allen Iverson, Jason Williams
item.description:
“Allen Iverson is one of my idols. I scored 23 points against him. It was a dream playing against him, he was like Jason Williams, he had a unique playing style that you enjoyed watching,”

Sergio Rodriguez on Allen Iverson, Jason Williams, May 4, 2020. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Kyle Korver on Allen Iverson
item.description:
“As I’ve gotten older, I’ve started to understand more and more how big he was for me early in my career. To have a superstar, he’s Allen Iverson,”

Kyle Korver on Allen Iverson, Jan 27, 2019. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Kyle Korver on Allen Iverson
item.description:
“Allen Iverson used to say, 'You know how hard it is to shoot 30 shots a game? You know how much energy it takes to shoot 30 shots a game?' And it's true,”

Kyle Korver on Allen Iverson, Apr 30, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Allen Iverson
item.description:
“I watched those videos and tried to make the same moves. That’s when I fell in love with basketball when I was 13-14. I was around his height. I didn’t know I would grow this tall. I had a Nuggets shirt that said ‘Iverson’. I would play out in the cold on that court making moves like Iverson.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Allen Iverson, Feb 15, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Bonzi Wells on Allen Iverson
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Bonzi Wells on Allen Iverson:

“Allen is the guy who drives our league … We were hoping that he was going to play for the fans.”

Bonzi Wells on Allen Iverson, Jul 17, 2017. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.

item.title: Tim Hardaway on Allen Iverson
item.description:
Hardaway told NBA.com's Scott Howard-Cooper.

“I had the original killer crossover and people are doing my move. They're not doing Allen Iverson's move. They're not doing nobody else's move. They're still trying to perfect my move as the killer crossover and it's my move, all right? That's the way it is. I brought a unique style to the game.”

Tim Hardaway on Allen Iverson, Apr 26, 2017. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Tim Hardaway on Allen Iverson
item.description:
Did you hear what Tim Hardaway said about your crossover?

“I'm going to tell you this and I tell everybody this: Allen Iverson carried the basketball,”

Tim Hardaway on Allen Iverson, Apr 26, 2017. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Allen Iverson
item.description:
But the relationship between Iverson and Thomas truly blossomed at All-Star weekend in Toronto in February, when Iverson sought out Thomas at an NBA event.

“[Iverson] came over and talked to me for like 30 minutes, just about how big of a fan he was of me,”

Isaiah Thomas on Allen Iverson, Nov 28, 2016. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Allen Iverson
item.description:
Jay King:Shaq on Allen Iverson:

“Some guys you foul them (hard) and you've got them. They'll never come again. He just kept coming.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Allen Iverson, Sep 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Amare Stoudemire on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Carmelo Anthony, Shaquille O'Neal, Allen Iverson, Steve Nash
item.description:
David 'Dubi' Pick: Amare Stoudemire:

“My all-time team of teammates: Steve Nash, Carmelo Anthony, Allen Iverson, Shaquille O'Neal - I would be power forward and Shag center - Dwyane Wade and LeBron James.”

Amare Stoudemire on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Carmelo Anthony, Shaquille O'Neal, Allen Iverson, Steve Nash, Aug 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @IAmDPick.

item.title: Brett Brown on Allen Iverson
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Brett Brown on Allen Iverson:

“He's six foot and he’s just bones, but he’s just all wrapped up in this fierce competitor.”

Brett Brown on Allen Iverson, Apr 4, 2016. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.
